# Jose Ramon Martinez Saavedra — Full Profile

> VP of Innovation at Quside Technologies. Builds verifiable entropy infrastructure for cybersecurity and accelerated computing.

## Identity

- Name: Jose Ramon Martinez Saavedra
- Titles: VP of Innovation (since 2023), Lead Scientist (since 2018)
- Organization: Quside Technologies S.L. (2018–present)
- Location: Barcelona, Spain
- Email: jrmsaavedra@gmail.com
- Website: https://jrmsaavedra.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/joseramasa
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/jrmsaavedra

## Professional Focus

Works on the randomness layer that cryptography and large-scale computing depend on, and on making it verifiable. Leads R&D across the entropy stack: photonic entropy sources and chips, FPGA and silicon implementations, PCIe/USB devices, drivers (Linux, Windows, FreeBSD) and SDKs. Recent public milestones: quside-curand, a cuRAND-style API that brings verifiable entropy to NVIDIA CUDA workflows (2026); a scalable VCSEL-based entropy source demonstrated with Coherent (2026); NIST SP 800-90B-compliant entropy sources; integration with post-quantum cryptography.

Also leads Quside's IP strategy (30+ patent families; co-inventor in 8 across US, EP, CN, JP) and competitive public funding (PI of EUR 5.6M+).

## Teaching & Outreach Tools

### PQC Course
Open course materials for Post-Quantum Cryptography. Lecture notes (159 pages) and Beamer slides (69 frames) in LaTeX. https://github.com/joseramasa/pqc-course

### NanophotonicsLab
Open browser-based nanophotonics simulation toolkit. Mie scattering, plasmonics, RCWA, BPM, laser calculators, and more. No installation required. https://nanophotonicslab.com

### El Fotonario
Interactive photonics education platform in Spanish. 9 courses, 145 exercises, 78 visualizations, 458-term glossary. https://joseramasa.github.io/fotonica/

### Science Outreach Books
Author of chapters in three collaborative popular science books in Spanish (all CC-licensed):
- Ciencia, y ademas lo entiendo (Ch. 62 & 63)
- Ciencia, y yo quiero ser cientifico (Ch. 70)
- Ciencia y otras easy pieces (Ch. 37)

### Side project: Con la Venia
Interactive visual novel for learning Spanish civil procedural law (Ren'Py). https://joseramasa.github.io/con-la-venia/
